name: @outlet/pact-tooling
description: Consumer-driven contracts (Pact v3 JSON) for mobile -> API and external adapter ports. Workspace-independent: not listed in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
$comment: @pact-foundation/pact is OPTIONAL. The in-repo harness (src/pact-dsl.ts) emits the same v3 JSON; see docs/engineering/pact.md for the swap. Runtime deps (vitest, yaml, swc, supertest, Nest) are borrowed from apps/api/node_modules and the root node_modules, so nothing needs installing to run offline.
